text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq and Jordan agree to increase Iraq's imports of goods under second phase of oil-for-food deal with U.N.
- Iraq conducting talks with Spanish company to buy food and medicine under oil deal.
- President Saddam Hussein chairs cabinet meeting which discusses cuts in electricity and Iraqi power grid.
(The above were also carried by QADISSIYA and THAWRA)
- Editoral urging new U.N. arms envoy Richard Butler not to bow to U.S. and Kuwaiti pressure.
